text.name: Snotted Up
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

name: Beartic
flavor_text: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

text.name: Continuous Headbutt
text.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

text.name: Sheer Cold
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

text.name: Drag Off
text.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 20 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

text.name: Call for Family
text.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

text.name: Hold Still
text.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

text.name: Dynamotor
text.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic {L} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Eelektross
flavor_text: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

text.name: Thunder Fang
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.name: Buzz Flip
text.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

name: Munna
flavor_text: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

text.name: Rest
text.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 30 damage from it.

name: Musharna
flavor_text: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

text.name: Dream Calling
text.text: You may search your deck for any number of Fennel cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.name: Sleep Pulse
text.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

name: Solosis
flavor_text: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Duosion
flavor_text: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

text.name: Cellular Evolution
text.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Elgyem
flavor_text: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.

text.name: Slight Shift
text.text: Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon.

name: Beheeyem
flavor_text: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

text.name: Calm Mind
text.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

text.name: Psychic
text.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Golett
flavor_text: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

text.name: Best Punch
text.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

text.name: Double Smash
text.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Timburr
flavor_text: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr
flavor_text: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

text.name: Hammer Arm
text.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

name: Conkeldurr
flavor_text: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

text.name: Craftsmanship
text.text: This Pokémon gets +40 HP for each {F} Energy attached to it.

text.name: Swing Around
text.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.

name: Throh
flavor_text: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

text.name: Shoulder Throw
text.text: This attack does 30 less damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

name: Dwebble
flavor_text: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

text.name: Flail
text.text: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

name: Crustle
flavor_text: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

text.name: Sturdy
text.text: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

text.name: Stone Edge
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Landorus
flavor_text: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

text.name: Abundant Harvest
text.text: Attach a Basic {F} Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

text.name: Earthquake
text.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Venipede
flavor_text: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

text.name: Poison Spray
text.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Whirlipede
flavor_text: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

text.name: Venoshock
text.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Scolipede
flavor_text: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

text.name: Poison Point
text.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.name: Venoshock
text.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 90 more damage.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

text.name: Tighten Up
text.text: Your opponent discards a card from their hand.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

text.name: Tighten Up
text.text: Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.

name: Krookodile
flavor_text: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

text.name: Tighten Up
text.text: Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.

text.name: Cursed Slug
text.text: If your opponent has 3 or fewer cards in their hand, this attack does 120 more damage.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

text.name: Wild Lances
text.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

name: Klink
flavor_text: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

text.name: Hard Gears
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Klang
flavor_text: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

text.name: Hard Gears
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Klinklang
flavor_text: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

text.name: Gear Coating
text.text: All of your Pokémon that have any {M} Energy attached take 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

text.name: Corner
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

text.name: Finishing Blow
text.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Cobalion
flavor_text: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

text.name: Righteous Edge
text.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.name: Metal Arms
text.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.

name: Axew
flavor_text: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

text.name: Gather Strength
text.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Fraxure
flavor_text: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.

text.name: Boundless Power
text.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

name: Haxorus
flavor_text: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

text.name: Cross-Cut
text.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.

text.name: Axe Blast
text.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it is Knocked Out.

name: Pidove
flavor_text: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

text.name: Scout
text.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

name: Tranquill
flavor_text: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.

text.name: Fly
text.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

name: Unfezant
flavor_text: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.

text.name: Add On
text.text: Draw 4 cards.

text.name: Swift Flight
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

name: Audino
flavor_text: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

text.name: Return
text.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

name: Minccino
flavor_text: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

text.name: Tail Slap
text.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

name: Cinccino
flavor_text: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

text.name: Do the Wave
text.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

name: Braviary
flavor_text: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

text.name: Aerial Ace
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

text.name: Regal Cheer
text.text: Attacks used by your Pokémon do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.name: Command the Grass
text.text: You may search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

flavor_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
